LESSON: COMMUNICATING TO

Grade: PP2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: GOD’S
Topic 1.5: Communicating to

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Communicating to. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do we talk to God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. mention simple prayers (5 Lessons) his/her spiritual nourishment
2. recite prayers for different times as part of his/her spiritual growth.
3. respect different times of prayer for his/her spiritual growth
4. appreciate prayer as one of the most 167 important way of talking to God. e) desire to pray at all times

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. mention simple prayers (5 Lessons) his/her spiritual nourishment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to mention simple prayers (5 Lessons) his/her spiritual nourishment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. recite prayers for different times as part of his/her spiritual growth.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recite prayers for different times as part of his/her spiritual growth. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. respect different times of prayer for his/her spiritual growth
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to respect different times of prayer for his/her spiritual growth. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. appreciate prayer as one of the most 167 important way of talking to God. e) desire to pray at all times
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate prayer as one of the most 167 important way of talking to God. e) desire to pray at all times. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Communicating to.
2. Explain Communicating to to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: You should 1. How do we talk to God? CREATION God through Prayer the learner should be able mention the different times 2. What times do you pray to to: they pray God a) mention simple prayers
4. Show that you can: mention simple prayers (5 Lessons) his/her spiritual nourishment
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Communicating to. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: How do we talk to God?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
